puntos: Backend: Introduction to Java and Spring Boot, dependency management with Maven, database connectivity, and cloud services integration.
Frontend: Application development with Angular and component communication.
Mobile Development: Introduction to Flutter and Android Studio, including a team-developed app presented at the end of the training.
Tools and Deployment: Version control with Git, introductory Docker training, and setting up projects with database integration.
AI Applied to Software Development: Use of AI-based models and tools within the development environment, including code refactoring and optimization.
Teamwork: Training on the internal Agora platform and several group projects involving the presentation of results.

proyectos.descripcion: Built an Android-first English learning platform with AI conversations, quizzes, and real-time human audio calls. Implemented low-latency communication, secure subscription payments, and a scalable backend for large concurrent learner traffic.

Developed and maintained a full-stack internship management system for onboarding, internship operations, secure payments, and certificate issuance, supporting hundreds of students across online and offline programs.

Built a client-focused EdTech solution with secure authentication, course enrollment, cloud-backed content management, and payment integration. Improved reliability and UX through optimized APIs, caching, and performance tuning.
